definitions.ask: Should this epic narrow how long a writing highlights scan holds bob_sync.lock?
definitions.why: On the Mac every 3 s-budget writer fails lock_busy for minutes, four times an hour

choices.label: Plan lock-free and lock only for intake and writes; lock_busy shrinks to the write phase
Skip the scan-lock phase; bob-cli-mo stays open for a later batch
Skip the scan-lock phase and close bob-cli-mo as canceled; plugin retry is enough
